clausesParaphrase: Tema 1.2 at basic course level requires interpreting simple pH titration curves and using pH titration to determine substance amounts/concentrations; multipart acid curves are marked LK.
The process competency combines planning, performing and evaluating quantitative acid/base concentration investigations, including titration curves.

facts.clauseParaphrase: C9.6 asks learners to describe metal behaviour in metal-salt solutions, interpret it at particle level as a redox reaction, and use partial redox equations to make electron release/uptake clear.
facts.shortQuote: Über die Formulierung von Redoxteilgleichungen verdeutlichen sie Elektronenabgabe und Elektronenaufnahme.

facts.clauseParaphrase: C13.3 grundlegend explicitly combines interpretation of titration curves, calculations at characteristic points, derivation of information about the substance and suitable indicators. A separate neighbouring competency plans/performs/documents titrations for concentration determination.
facts.shortQuote: interpretieren Titrationskurven und führen Berechnungen zu charakteristischen Punkten einer Titrationskurve durch
